ui.title: Doodle Battlefield
ui.hint.empty: Tap a squad to select. Tap an empty tile or press and hold a tile to inspect terrain.
ui.hint.selected: Gold: can move. Red tile: can attack. Red dot: firing range. Green tile: merge.
ui.hint.confirm: Tap the target again or press Attack to confirm.
ui.capture.title: Capture
ui.win.title: Victory!
ui.lose.title: Defeat
ui.win.elimination: The enemy has been wiped off the battlefield.
ui.toast.noSplit: This squad cannot split right now.
ui.toast.pickSplit: Pick an adjacent tile for the new squad.
unit.desc.militia: Cheap, poorly armed. Spears counter cavalry. Merge into regulars to restore them.
unit.desc.infantry: Main melee force, sturdy. Beats archers and militia.
unit.desc.archer: Fires 2–3 tiles, cannot fire when engaged. Farther from hills.
unit.desc.cavalry: Fast, strong charge. Fears militia spears. Cannot climb mountains; bogs down badly in swamps.
terrain.note.forest: Orcs gain: better defense, easier movement.
terrain.note.hill: High ground: hits harder, archers shoot farther.
terrain.note.mountain: Slow going, cavalry cannot climb. High ground: hits harder.
terrain.note.village: Heals a squad that ends its turn here.
terrain.note.stronghold: Heals its owner's squads. Hold 2 turns to win.
ui.rotate: Landscape is easier to play in
weather.wet: Flooded by rain: dries out in {n} turn(s).
ui.toast.pickFire: Pick a forest tile to set ablaze
fire.burning: Burning, dies down in {n} turn(s). Nobody can enter; units inside lose 1 troop per turn. May spread downwind; rain puts it out.
terrain.note.burnt: Scorched woods: plays like open plain, no cover left.
fog.preview: A shadow in the woods: unknown unit, damage and counter can't be predicted. Attacking reveals it.
fog.desc: Something hides in these woods; type and size unknown. It shows itself when it moves, attacks or is attacked.
terrain.note.peak: Sheer rock, cannot be climbed or crossed. Go around.
terrain.note.swamp: Mire: slow, lowers defense and damage. Cavalry bog down even worse.
ui.tiles: Pixel-art terrain (pines, rocks, grass with shadows)
ui.tiles.on: Pixel-art terrain: on (tap for hand-drawn paper)
ui.tiles.off: Hand-drawn paper: on (tap for pixel-art terrain)
ui.splash.sub: Turn-based tactics on a hand-drawn map
ui.splash.note: Turn the sound on for the best experience
ui.win.survive: Your forces held to the end.
ui.win.destroyed: The enemy camp has been razed.
unit.desc.objective: Losing it means defeat. Static, never fights back, nobody can stand on it. Squads next to their own camp recover 2 troops per turn. Archers and cavalry do poorly against it.
mission.lead.skirmish: Capture the enemy stronghold or wipe out the enemy.
mission.lead.hold: Hold your stronghold until turn {n} ends.
mission.lead.destroy: Raze the enemy camp before they raze yours.
mission.lead.escort: Bring the commander to the extraction point and protect them at all costs.
mission.win.skirmish.1: Capture the enemy stronghold and hold it 2 turns
mission.lose.skirmish.1: The enemy captures your stronghold and holds it 2 turns
mission.win.hold.2: Or capture the enemy stronghold and hold it 2 turns
mission.lose.hold.1: The enemy captures your stronghold and holds it 2 turns
mission.note.hold.1: The enemy outnumbers you from the start
mission.note.hold.2: Both sides get more troops partway; the turn is shown in the top bar
mission.win.destroy.1: Raze the enemy camp: attack it like a squad
mission.note.destroy.1: Each camp has 10 HP, never fights back, and cannot be captured
mission.note.destroy.2: Squads next to their own camp recover 2 troops per turn
mission.note.destroy.3: Infantry and militia do well; archers and cavalry do poorly
mission.win.escort.1: Bring the commander to the extraction point (gold flag tile)
mission.note.escort.1: No strongholds, no capturing, no time limit
mission.note.escort.2: The commander (gold banner) cannot merge into other squads, but others can merge into the commander to heal
ui.save.title: Save / load
ui.save.where.remote: Saved to your account. Survives clearing browser data.
ui.save.where.local: Saved in this browser only; may be lost if site data is cleared. Export a file to keep it.
ui.save.cannotNow: You can only save on your turn, when nothing is animating.
ui.save.savedLocal: Saved in browser (not on your account)
ui.flee.exitElite: About to leave the battle! Loses 1 level
unit.desc.goblin: Hides in forests and only shows itself when it attacks or leaves the forest. Enemies stepping next to its hiding spot are stopped and ambushed (no counterattack). Orc squads within 2 tiles recover 1 extra troop per turn. Does not count for wiping out an army.
ui.toast.ambushed: Ambushed by goblins! This move can no longer be undone.
unit.desc.necromancer: Commander of the undead host; casts dark bolts 2–3 tiles away, frail body. Fallen enemies leave graves; graves within 7 tiles of the necromancer rise as undead at half strength after 2 turns. If the necromancer falls, the whole host collapses into lifeless corpses.
unit.desc.undead: Undead: no morale, never flees; hits as hard as when alive but moves 1 tile less. Collapses if the necromancer dies.
ui.win.necromancer: The necromancer has fallen; the undead host collapses into lifeless corpses.
ui.lose.necromancer: Our necromancer has fallen; the whole host falls apart.
ui.win.necro_fled: The necromancer fled the battlefield; without its master the undead host collapses into lifeless corpses.
ui.lose.necro_fled: Our necromancer fled; the whole host falls apart.
unit.desc.marine: Moves 1 tile farther than militia. Next to a forest it can cut timber (1 turn); with timber, next to water it can launch (1 turn) and becomes an archer in a boat.
unit.desc.marineboat: Archer in a boat: shoots 2–3 tiles, moves only on rivers and lakes, cannot pass under bridges. Move onto a shore tile to land (the boat stays); move onto the boat to board again.
grave.title: Grave of the fallen: {unit}
grave.ready: Rises at the start of the next undead turn
grave.inRange: Within the necromancer's curse ({r} tiles): rises fast
grave.outRange: Outside the necromancer's curse ({r} tiles): still rises, but slower
grave.note: A squad on or next to the grave can Bury the fallen (uses that squad's turn): the soldiers are laid to rest and the necromancer can no longer raise them. Risen undead return at half strength and stay dead if they fall again.
mission.flank: At the start of turn {turn}, {n} {side} reinforcement squad(s) appear around this flag (flanking attack).
mission.note.hold.undead: Undead: reinforcements rise at the map edge beside our stronghold, marked by flags with the turn number; on longer maps the undead get extra turns
tut.blocked: Follow the tutorial on the left (or press Skip).
tut.basics.intro: Welcome to Doodle Battlefield! Blue is your army, red are the Orcs. This lesson covers moving, reading terrain and attacking, about 3 minutes.
tut.basics.inspect: Every tile has its own effect. Tap the hill marked with the blue arrow to inspect it.
tut.basics.hill: The panel on the right shows what a tile does. A hill is high ground: units on it hit harder, archers shoot farther, and they defend better.
tut.basics.select: Tap the infantry (the swordsman under the blue arrow) to select it.
tut.basics.move: Yellow tiles are where the infantry can go. Tap the hill, then press the Move here button that appears on it.
tut.basics.wait: The infantry is on the hill but no enemy is in reach yet. Press Hold to end its turn.
tut.basics.archer: Archers shoot from 2–3 tiles away and take no counterattack when shooting from range. Tap the archers.
tut.basics.target: Enemies with a red tile under them can be attacked. Tap the Orc raiders under the blue arrow to preview the attack.
tut.basics.preview: No dice: the panel at the top shows exactly the damage you deal and take. Tap the target again or press Attack.
tut.basics.end: All your squads have acted. Press End turn to let the Orcs move.
tut.basics.free: Your turn again. You are in command now: defeat every Orc to win. Tip: attack from the hill, and attack when allies stand next to the target (flanking) to hit harder.
tut.win.title: Tutorial complete!
tut.win.text: You can now select, move, read terrain and attack. Every faction and unit has its own strengths: tap a unit to read its description. Into battle!
tut.lose.title: Not quite
tut.lose.text: Try again: fight from the hill and attack from several sides at once.
